text: Vestibule, facing south (yaw -90) right after Continue: an empty black rectangle (~x370-910, y45-96) sits at top-center and covers the middle of the NEXT objective text ('through the Screen ro... door'), cutting it off.

Staircase C landing (x-11.0 z15.9) looking back at the vestibule doorway (yaw ~178): a pure-black strip runs along the floor at the doorway threshold, the full door width - looks like a gap in the floor/void showing through. Seen in shots/st_b.png too. Also the screen room's far doorway shows the same dark band.

Staircase after running up one flight (x-11.4 z17.2 y4.8, yaw ~125): HUD chip says 'on the stairs - level with the door' and probe says staircase door is 1.4m ahead (bearing -6), but the view shows only a flat dark wall with a D sign - no doorway. Walking forward (pt walkto door) presses into the wall and times out; player is stuck facing a wall where the exit should be.

Leaving the staircase back to the vestibule: from the C landing, walking toward the doorway kept snagging (walkto door timed out twice, ~0.2 m/s progress while holding w) - the player slides on the dark door jamb / bottom step until strafing sideways. Took ~2 real minutes to get out.

Vestibule looking north up the corridor (x-9.1 z21.4, yaw ~96): at the doorway on the right into the Screen room, a pure-black wedge shows at floor level along the door jamb (lower right of centre) - the void under/behind the wall is visible. Same kind of black strip as at the staircase doorway threshold.

Screen room (x-5.1 z11.9), looking at the west door to the vestibule: a dotted line of light pixels runs down the inside edge of the door jamb (a seam where the jamb meets the wall/opening, z-fighting or a crack). Same dotted column seen on the List door jamb (shots/list3.png, left edge) and in shots/sc_4.png. Expected solid jamb edges.

Hall, trying to enter the Machine door (east): pt walkto door reports 'within reach' at 0.8-1.2 m with bearing -5, but the view is a flat wall filling the screen; holding w does not move the player (x stuck at ~5.7-5.85). Same doorway snag as staircase, list corridor (x-9.1 z19.3) and list door: player sticks to door jambs with no sliding and must strafe/re-aim several times. Could not get into the Machine room in ~3 real minutes.
